description:
Join roles are roles that get automatically applied to members when they join the server. You can set up to 3 join roles, and they will be given to every new member, including bots.

If the server has membership screening enabled, members will only receive the join roles once they have completed the screening.

data.title: Join roles
data.description:
These roles are given to members when they join the server

<@&Minecrafter>

tabs.name: Adding a join role
content: To add a join role, use the <command:joinrole [role]|role joinrole role:[role]> command. Both you and Wynem require the **Manage Roles** permission.

data.title: Join role added
data.description: The role <@&Member> is now a join role

content: The role is now a join role, and will be given to members when they join the server.
The role must be below both your and Wynem's highest role level, and managed roles, such as bot roles and the server booster role, are not supported.
A server can have up to 3 join roles. If you try to add any more, you will get an error.

author: Error

data.title: Too many join roles

tabs.name: Viewing the join roles
content: To view the current join roles, use the <command:joinrole|role joinrole> command without providing a role.

data.title: No join roles
data.description:
There are currently no join roles configured in this server

Use the formatting `e!joinrole <role>` to add a new join role

tabs.name: Removing a join role
content: To remove a join role, run the same command again with a role that is already a join role.

data.title: Join role removed
data.description: The role <@&Member> is no longer a join role

content: The role is no longer a join role, and will not be given to new members.
If a join role gets deleted from the server, it is automatically removed from the join roles.

description: Wynem requires the **Manage Roles** permission to be able to apply the join roles. If the permission gets removed, Wynem will send an error message to the server when a member joins.
